mandatoryFindings.title: Selected pre-native current check requires its own future drain receipt
mandatoryFindings.evidence: Actual Controller.selected claims selected-consumed.json, then calls actual namespace verification through pre-native current. With no relay launched and no selected-drain yet, verifier calls root_document(selected-drain.json) and fails. Guarded reproduction preserves consumed1/HOLD/native0 and shows the drain is written only afterward by selected finally. Thus the legitimate first selected attempt cannot reach relay/native launch.

mandatoryFindings.title: Main closes relay-owned output custody while an unresolved relay thread retains it
mandatoryFindings.evidence: Relay.stop explicitly returns unresolved while retaining thread/descriptors; the relay output is Effects.unit. Actual main finally unconditionally calls effects.unit.close(). Guarded actual-main cases with a live relay thread record close:control and close:relay-output despite unresolved ownership. This removes retained ancestor FDs from another thread, contrary to the required unresolved-ownership contract.
mandatoryFindings.requiredCorrection: Do not close custody descriptors still owned or usable by an unresolved relay. Keep actual thread/output/descriptor references and immutable partial receipts until independently confirmed termination/close or a separate exact disposition. Cover unresolved READY/serve/fsync/stop/exception paths and the joined positive path; do not force-close from another thread or fabricate drain.

mandatoryFindings.title: First-seen root controls are parsed under self-derived hashes rather than externally bound pins
mandatoryFindings.source: public_observation_unit.py:Effects.root_document/local_hash, require_root_phase_decision, read_readiness_and_separate_root_permit, qualified_expected_wrapper_exit, actual_wrapper_tool_result; main CLI
mandatoryFindings.evidence: With expected=None and an empty invocation-local loaded_local map, root_document accepts any first raw JSON buffer, sets loaded_local[name]=sha(raw), then decodes it. New CLI invocations start a fresh map. Guarded actual-reader worlds accept two different root-actual-evidence-disposition buffers under the same external release, with no independent expected hash supplied. Later semantic and prior-evidence checks do not supply the required hash-before-first-interpretation barrier for that root control itself.
mandatoryFindings.requiredCorrection: Bind reached existing immutable control JSON to independently supplied root/operator pins before parsing. Use per-entry explicit control/adoption/permit/wrapper SHA or an independently pinned acyclic root pin record; verify the SAME consumed buffer. Keep literal holder one-way binding without a release/active self-hash cycle. Map the complete reached closure; add wrong/missing/substituted first-read cases across decisions, admissions, journals, collection, disposition, readiness, permit and wrapper inputs. Do not read the real baseline during preparation.
